text:
Microwaves and X-rays are regions of the electromagnetic spectrum.
Which statement about microwaves and X-rays is correct?
A
Microwaves and X-rays have the same frequency.
B
Microwaves and X-rays travel at the same speed in a vacuum.
C
Microwaves have a shorter wavelength than X-rays.
D
Microwaves travel at a lower speed than X-rays in a vacuum.

options.label: A
options.text: Microwaves and X-rays have the same frequency.

options.label: B
options.text: Microwaves and X-rays travel at the same speed in a vacuum.

options.label: C
options.text: Microwaves have a shorter wavelength than X-rays.

options.label: D
options.text: Microwaves travel at a lower speed than X-rays in a vacuum.
